common.api_proxy_mode-tips: Controls this storage's HTTP/HTTPS API requests, including login, token refresh and file management. System uses OpenList proxy_address first, then HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY environment variables. Disabled forces a direct connection.
common.api_proxy_url-tips: Manual proxy URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://user:password@host:1080. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H.
common.transfer_proxy_mode-tips: Controls HTTP/HTTPS file uploads and downloads made by OpenList. System uses proxy_address first, then proxy environment variables. Existing direct links, browser transfers and external download proxy servers keep their current behavior. Native FTP/SFTP/SMB connections are unaffected.
common.transfer_proxy_url-tips: Manual proxy URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://user:password@host:1080. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H.
common.proxy_url_required: Enter a proxy URL for each proxy set to Manual.
common.export_tips: Please copy the storage JSON above.
common.import_tips: Paste the exported storage JSON to import.
common.mount_path-tips: The path you want to mount to, it is unique and cannot be repeated
common.cache_expiration-tips: The cache expiration time for this storage (minutes)
common.custom_cache_policies-tips: The cache expiration rules for this storage (minutes)
common.disable_proxy_sign-tips: Disable sign for download proxy URL
